officialInstructions.scope: MRT gantry to library entrance via Lobby L
steps: Exit the MRT gantry towards VivoCity and take the ramp up.
Pass Guzman y Gomez to lift Lobby L beside KFC.
Take the lift to Level 3, turn left on exit, then exit the mall and turn left.
Follow the sheltered walkway past Food Republic, Golden Village and Pet Safari.
Enter the mall ahead for the library entrance.
